findings.passage: “I am immensely honored to be recognized by the Arizona Citizens Defense League,” said Representative Bliss. “They are a terrific organization, dedicated to legislative action in support of the Second Amendment. Like them, I believe fervently in safeguarding our citizens’ right to bear arms – a cornerstone of our Constitution. As a state legislator, it is my privilege to work alongside fellow Arizonans in safeguarding and preserving the freedoms that define our great state, and to stand against any attempts to undermine those cherished liberties.”
findings.note: Her statement in an official House news release on receiving a 2023 award from a gun-rights group for Second Amendment support. She says she believes strongly in safeguarding the right to bear arms and opposes attempts to undermine it.
subjects: general statement on gun rights and the Second Amendment

findings.passage: "We're not advocating to go out and find the active shooter, we're advocating for them to protect their children in the best manner possible," ... "And this is the very last step if they were pushed to that situation."
findings.note: Quoted by ABC15 on HB 2022, which she sponsored (the outlet says a gun-rights group wrote it): it would let teachers and school staff carry guns on campus. She describes it as a last step to protect children.
subjects: armed teachers and school staff
carrying guns in schools

findings.passage: "This will require proficiency beyond a police officer's training," she said. "It's incredibly intense to be able to get to this level."
findings.note: Quoted by ABC15 on the training standard that HB 2022 would require of school staff who carry guns.
subjects: armed teachers and school staff
training required to carry a gun

findings.passage: “The purpose of this bill is for children to learn about firearm safety from qualified individuals with the focus on safety rather than on popular culture in various forms of media,” said Bliss, a nurse, concealed weapons instructor and mother.
findings.note: Quoted by Cronkite News (carried by Copper Courier) on HB 2332, which she sponsored: an optional firearms safety training elective in grades six to twelve.
subjects: firearm safety training in schools

findings.passage: Proud Member of the National Rifle Association, Board Member of the Arizona State Rifle and Pistol Association, Member of the Arizona Citizens Defense League, and Member of The Well-Armed Woman - Gunsite and Chino Valley Chapters
findings.note: From the biography page of her campaign site (the page is undated; it refers to 2026 awards). She lists her memberships in gun-rights and shooting groups.
subjects: general statement on gun rights and the Second Amendment

findings.passage: NRA-ILA supports candidates that stand for the protection of the Second Amendment which guarantees a citizen’s right to keep and bear arms. Officially endorsed by the NRA with an A rating.
